title: Pomodoro Technique
description: Study for 25 minutes, then take a short break before starting another focused session.

title: Flashcards
description: Review key concepts using question and answer cards to practice active recall.

title: Cornell Notes
description: Divide notes into sections for main ideas, details, and summaries after class.

title: Mind Mapping
description: Connect ideas visually to understand how topics relate to one another.

title: Active Recall
description: Try to remember information without looking at notes, then check what you missed.

title: Practice Testing
description: Use sample questions regularly to prepare for the format and pressure of exams.

title: Weekly Planner
description: Plan assignments, study sessions, and deadlines at the beginning of each week.

title: Goal Setting
description: Create realistic academic goals and break them into smaller steps.

title: Study Groups
description: Discuss topics, compare notes, and solve problems with classmates.

title: Reading Strategies
description: Preview headings, ask questions, highlight carefully, and summarize what you read.

title: Time Blocking
description: Assign blocks of time to specific tasks so your day has a clear structure.

title: Healthy Sleep
description: Maintain a consistent sleep schedule so your brain can rest and process information.
